integrity: The all-parameter result is algebraically proved; finite computations are independent examples rather than substitutes for the proof. Independent mathematical validation is unperformed.
scientific_limitations: Finite label groups and partial inner conjugation only; no claim about the full partial automorphism monoid or all element orders. Historical priority against unindexed projective-wreath enumeration remains unverified.
title: Central-square involution spectra of projective rook inverse monoids
